#  14720 - Technology and Innovation Management Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **14720**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Technology and Innovation Management**  |  
|  Technologie- und Innovationsmanagement   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Energy Systems   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Wilhelm, Benno 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After completing this module, students will be able to:
  * Apply key concepts and tools of Technology and Innovation Management (according to contents)
  * Select and confidently apply appropriate methods of Technology and Innovation Management
  * Independently expand their knowledge in Technology and Innovation Management
  * Analyse and structure complex tasks in Technology and Innovation Management
  * Generate and implement new ideas in Technology and Innovation Management
  * Continually prepare and evaluate source material of Technology and Innovation Management
  * Assess current trends in Technology and Innovation Management
  * Present ideas and concepts confidently and convincingly

 |  
| Contents:  | Innovation as a Strategic Imperative 
  * Degrees of Innovation
  * Classifications of Innovations
  * Requirements for the Management of Radical Innovations
  * Success Factors of Innovation Management
  * Evaluation of Innovation Projects
  * Innovation Strategies for Industry

Innovation Management
  * Management of the Innovation Process
  * Using Internal and External Sources for Innovation
  * Corporate Structures and Cultures Conducive to Innovation
  * Systematization of the Innovation Process
  * Innovation Funnel
  * Dimensions of Innovation Management

Practical Problems and Case Studies
  * Technology Management
  * Formulating R&D Strategies
  * Technological Competitive Analysis
  * Technological Forecasting

R&D Investment Decisions
  * R&D Portfolio Management
  * External Technology Procurement
  * R&D Alliances and M&A
  * Management of Foreign R&D Units
  * Research Management
  * Knowledge Management
  * R&D Personnel Management
  * External Technology Exploitation and Patent Management

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Study project / 60 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Trott, P.: Innovation Management & New Product Development, 2017
  * Floyd, Ch.: Managing technology for corporate success, 1997
  * Tidd, J. et al: Managing Innovation, 2018
  * Afuah,A.: Innovation Management, 2003
  * Utterback, J.: Mastering the Dynamics of Innovation, 1994


  * Case studies will be announced at the beginning of the course

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Five individual exercises (one written page each) for 2% each (total 10%)
  * Group exercise A (approx. 6 written pages) with presentation (approx. 30 minutes) for 10%
  * Group exercise B (approx. 6 written pages) with presentation (approx. 30 minutes) for 10%
  * Written exam of 85 minutes for 70%

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |
